rows.reason: Actual indices (zero-based): user5 asks 'güncel ekstre borcum', but extraction9 selects u_detail=total; evaluator13 stores wanted_detail=total. Balance succeeds17 and18 contains correct9Oct statement,7200TL,2880minimum,19Octdue and zero FXblocks. Narrow total branch yields incomplete normal-statement reading22/32 without statement date/minimum/due and with separate zero sentences. Actualpre-evaluation18 replay reproduces this; changing only wanted_detail=all restores all normal statement fields and combined zero sentence. This is an interpretation/extraction failure, not missing or wrongHTTPservice data. Privacy requests afterward were refused correctly.
